requirement: User should be able to reset their password using their registered email.

test_cases.title: Reset password with valid registered email
test_cases.description: Verify that a registered user can request a password reset.
test_cases.expected_result: A password reset email is sent to the registered address.
gherkin: Given the user has a registered account
When the user requests a password reset using the registered email
Then a password reset email should be sent
edge_cases: Email address with leading or trailing spaces
Registered email using a different domain
test_cases.automation_suggestion: Automate with Playwright using the password reset page and validate the confirmation message and email notification.
test_cases.automation_code:
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect


def test_reset_password(page: Page):
    page.goto("/forgot-password")
    page.fill("#email", "registered_user@example.com")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    expect(page.get_by_text("Check your email")).to_be_visible()

test_cases.description: Verify the behavior when an unregistered email is submitted.
test_cases.preconditions: The email address is not associated with an account.
test_cases.expected_result: The system handles the request according to the defined security policy without exposing account information.

test_cases.title: Reset password with invalid email format
test_cases.description: Verify validation of an incorrectly formatted email address.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays an appropriate email validation message.

test_cases.title: Reset password with empty email
test_cases.description: Verify that the reset request cannot be submitted without an email.
test_cases.expected_result: The system requires the email field and does not submit the request.
test_cases.automation_code:
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect


def test_reset_password_empty_email(page: Page):
    page.goto("/forgot-password")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    expect(page.get_by_text("required")).to_be_visible()

test_cases.title: Reset password using an expired reset link
test_cases.description: Verify that an expired password reset link cannot be used.
test_cases.preconditions: A password reset link has expired.
test_steps: Open the expired password reset link.
Attempt to define a new password.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the expired link and asks the user to request a new reset link.
test_cases.automation_code:
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect


def test_reset_password_expired_link(page: Page):
    page.goto("/forgot-password?token=expired")
    expect(page.get_by_text("expired")).to_be_visible()
